description: RUGGED, CAPABLE, BARELY TOUCHED, NO-ACCIDENT, NONSMOKER, READY TO GET TO WORK! The 2025 Nissan Frontier S enters the midsize truck class with a formula that keeps things refreshingly simple: a strong standard V6, genuine capability, and none of the unnecessary complexity some rivals pile on. Showing a barely-touched 5,500 miles and finished in a handsome Super Black, this Frontier is ready to start its working life almost exactly as it left the factory. Built in a Crew Cab configuration with true 4x4 capability, this Frontier gives owners the flexibility to haul the whole crew during the week and head off the pavement on the weekend. The 4x4 system adds genuine confidence on gravel, mud, and light snow, while the Crew Cab's four full-size doors make everyday access easy for passengers and gear alike. Why Shoppers Buy This Model The Frontier has built its reputation the old-fashioned way: a fully boxed ladder frame, a proven V6 engine, and a no-nonsense approach that appeals to buyers who want a truck that simply works. Its VQ-series-derived engine family has a long track record for durability, and that heritage carries through to the current generation's standard 3.8-liter V6. Shoppers cross-shopping the midsize truck field appreciate that the Frontier doesn't ask them to step up to a pricier trim just to get real capability, and its fully boxed frame and simple mechanical layout have helped it build a loyal following among buyers who use their trucks for actual work rather than just the school run. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition Reviewers evaluating the current-generation Frontier consistently highlight its standard 310-horsepower V6 as a genuine strength in the segment, praising the smooth power delivery and the confident low-end torque that makes towing and off-road driving feel easier than the numbers alone suggest. The ride quality and interior refinement have also drawn favorable comparisons to trucks that once felt like a clear step above the Frontier. Editors do note that some rivals edge it out on maximum towing and payload figures, but the overall consensus is that the Frontier delivers dependable, comfortable, work-ready performance at a genuinely competitive price point. Warranty The odometer is hovering around the 5,500-mile mark on this practically new Frontier, and it is STILL COVERED by Nissan's factory protection. Remaining Transferable Factory Coverage Basic Limited Warranty -- Covers virtually every system in the vehicle for 3 years or 36,000 miles from the original in-service date, whichever comes first. Powertrain Limited Warranty -- Covers the engine, transmission, and drive axle for 5 years or 60,000 miles from the original in-service date, whichever comes first. Given this Frontier's current 2025 model year and low mileage, meaningful coverage remains active under either measure regardless of the exact in-service date; the buyer or dealer should verify the precise remaining term with Nissan using the VIN. Extended service plans may be available to provide additional peace of mind and help protect your investment moving forward. Standard Features Even in S trim, this Frontier comes well equipped for daily work and driving. An 8-inch touchscreen with wired Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keeps smartphone integration simple, while a 7-inch driver information display puts key vehicle data right in the driver's line of sight. Nissan's Safety Shield 360 suite of driver-assistance technology comes standard as well, giving every Frontier buyer a genuinely comprehensive safety baseline without having to step up the lineup. Installed Options Splash Guards Helps protect the lower body panels and undercarriage from road debris, mud, and moisture kicked up by the tires. Truck Capability This Frontier's fully boxed frame and standard V6 power translate into genuine everyday usefulness. Properly equipped, this Crew Cab 4x4 is rated to tow up to 6,960 pounds, making it a capable choice for a boat, small camper, or utility trailer, while a maximum payload of up to 1,330 pounds handles building materials, mulch, or a bed full of gear with room to spare. The 5-foot bed measures 59.5 inches long and 61.4 inches wide, with 44.5 inches of usable space between the wheel wells, giving owners a genuinely practical footprint for hauling without stepping up to a larger, harder-to-park truck. Mechanical Features Power comes from Nissan's 3.8-liter V6, rated at 310 horsepower and 281 lb-ft of torque, paired with a smooth-shifting 9-speed automatic transmission that keeps the engine in its sweet spot whether cruising the highway or working a job site. This engine family has earned a strong reputation for long-term durability, giving owners real confidence in the miles ahead. This Frontier's 4x4 system adds an extra layer of capability and confidence, sending power to all four wheels when road or trail conditions call for it, without complicating the truck's straightforward, work-ready character. Exterior Features The current Frontier's squared-off styling gives it a purposeful, tough-truck stance that stands apart from the more rounded, car-like shapes some competitors have adopted. LED headlights improve visibility and give the front end a modern edge, while the Super Black finish keeps the overall look clean and easy to maintain. Interior Features Inside, this Frontier's cabin balances comfort with genuine durability. Cloth seating stands up well to daily work use, while the Crew Cab's four-door layout provides real passenger space for a family or crew rather than a cramped afterthought. Infotainment & Technology The 8-inch touchscreen provides an easy-to-use interface for audio, phone, and vehicle settings, and wired Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep smartphone-based navigation and media just a cable away. The 7-inch driver display rounds out a straightforward, distraction-light technology setup that focuses on the essentials. Safety Features Nissan's Safety Shield 360 suite equips this Frontier with a strong baseline of driver-assistance technology, including automatic emergency braking, blind spot warning, rear cross traffic alert, lane departure warning, and high beam assist. Together, these systems help reduce driver workload and add genuine peace of mind on every trip. ... and there's SO MUCH more! description: Bright Silver gives this 2019 Kia Soul Base a simple, clean appearance, and the boxy hatchback shape is exactly what has made the Soul such a useful choice for drivers who want small-car maneuverability with more interior flexibility than a traditional sedan. With 95,546 miles, front-wheel drive, a four-cylinder engine and a six-speed automatic transmission with Sportmatic, this Soul is built around straightforward everyday transportation for Wesley Chapel, Tampa and the surrounding Bay area.  The four-cylinder powertrain keeps the mechanical formula uncomplicated. Power is sent to the front wheels through a six-speed automatic, a familiar combination that works well for commuting, errands and normal highway travel. The Soul's compact exterior dimensions make it easy to place in traffic, fit into tighter parking spaces and maneuver through crowded shopping centers, while the tall roof and upright body help create a cabin that feels more open than many conventional compact cars.  That packaging is one of the Soul's biggest advantages. The report confirms cloth seating, and the hatchback body makes it easier to use the rear cargo area for groceries, luggage, school gear, pet supplies or the everyday items that can be awkward in a sedan trunk. The taller body also makes entry, exit and cargo loading straightforward. For someone who does not need a full-size SUV but still wants a practical shape, the Soul occupies a useful middle ground.  The Base trim keeps the focus on value rather than excess. Its approachable dimensions make it a good candidate for a first car, commuter, student vehicle, second household car or runabout. Bright Silver is also an easy color to live with in Florida, giving the Soul a clean appearance that suits its practical mission.  With 95,546 miles, this Soul should be viewed as an experienced used vehicle rather than a near-new one, but that is also where its market position can make sense. Buyers shopping this mileage range are often looking for affordability, utility and manageable size more than prestige. The Soul answers that need with a useful hatchback layout, a conventional automatic transmission and a compact footprint that can handle everything from a Wesley Chapel commute to weekend trips into Tampa, St. Petersburg or Clearwater.  This 2019 Kia Soul qualifies for Ford Blue Certified status through Ford Blue Advantage. Blue Certified vehicles can include qualifying non-Ford makes and complete a 139-point inspection by Ford factory-trained technicians. Certification includes a 90-day/4,000-mile Comprehensive Limited Warranty, 24/7 Ford Roadside Assistance, a CARFAX Vehicle History Report, Ford Rewards eligibility and additional Ford Blue Advantage benefits. Program terms, age and mileage limits and coverage conditions apply; Parks Ford of Wesley Chapel can provide complete details. Exceptionally equipped with the desirable Prestige Package and Black Optic Package, along with Audi Beam e-tron Logo and Rear Side Airbags, this Q8 e-tron combines commanding design, luxurious appointments, advanced technology, and refined electric quattro® performance.    Prestige Package ($10,400 value)  Digital Matrix-Design LED Headlights Front Passenger Seat Memory Head-Up Display Individual Contour Front Seats with Massage and Ventilation Intersection Assist Leather-Trimmed Dashboard, Armrests, and Center Console LED Interior Lighting Plus Package Manual Sunshades for Rear Doors Park Assist Plus Power Soft-Closing Doors Singleframe Projector Lighting Valcona/Milano Leather Seats   Black Optic Package ($2,000 value)  21 5-Arm Aero Structure Design Wheels with Bi-Color Finish All-Season Tires Black Exterior Trim and Roof Rails   Audi Beam e-tron Logo ($485 value)  Rear Side Airbags ($400 value)   Dealer Installed Accessories: StarGard GPS Vehicle Protection ClearShield Protection    Key Features:    Prestige Package: Elevates the Q8 e-tron with an exceptional collection of luxury and technology including Digital Matrix-design LED headlights, Head-Up Display, massaging and ventilated individual contour front seats, Valcona/Milano leather, Park Assist Plus, and power soft-closing doors.   Black Optic Package: Provides a striking contrast against the Glacier White Metallic exterior with black exterior trim, black roof rails, and 21 bi-color aero-design wheels.   114 kWh High-Voltage Battery: The large-capacity battery provides the foundation for impressive range, strong dual-motor performance, and the refined all-electric driving experience expected from Audi.   285-Mile EPA-Estimated Range: When fully charged, the Q8 e-tron carries an original EPA-estimated 285 miles of driving range, providing excellent flexibility for daily driving and longer journeys.   170 kW DC Fast-Charging Capability: Supports high-speed DC charging at compatible stations, while the onboard 9.6 kW AC charger provides convenient charging flexibility at home and on the road.   quattro® All-Wheel Drive: Dual electric motors provide responsive power delivery and confident all-wheel-drive traction across changing road and weather conditions.   Adaptive Air Suspension: Delivers a refined balance of comfort and control while helping the Q8 e-tron maintain its composed luxury-SUV character.   Individual Contour Front Seats: Premium Valcona/Milano leather seats with heating, ventilation, and massage functionality create an exceptionally comfortable environment for longer drives.   Head-Up Display: Projects important driving information into the driver's forward field of vision, helping keep essential information easy to reference.   Digital Matrix-Design LED Headlights: Advanced Audi lighting technology delivers sophisticated illumination while giving the Q8 e-tron a distinctive presence after dark.   Audi Virtual Cockpit Plus: Audi's advanced digital instrument display places navigation, vehicle information, and electric-driving data directly in front of the driver.   MMI® Navigation Plus: Audi's dual-screen MMI touch response system provides intuitive access to navigation, entertainment, connectivity, climate, and vehicle functions.   Adaptive Cruise Assist with Lane Guidance: Provides additional driver support during compatible highway driving by helping manage speed, following distance, and lane positioning.   Park Assist Plus: Provides additional assistance during compatible parking maneuvers, complementing the vehicle's front and rear parking sensors and rearview camera.   Power Soft-Closing Doors: Add an extra level of refinement by gently drawing the doors securely closed when they are brought near the latch position.   Panoramic Sunroof: The expansive glass roof with electric sunshade brings natural light into the Black cabin and enhances its open, premium atmosphere.   Four-Zone Automatic Climate Control: Allows individualized climate settings throughout the cabin and works with comfort pre-conditioning and a heat pump for enhanced electric-vehicle comfort.   Audi Advanced Key & Power Tailgate: Provides convenient keyless access and easy cargo-area operation for everyday usability.   Heated Steering Wheel with Regenerative Braking Paddles: Combines cold-weather comfort with convenient driver control over regenerative braking behavior.   Advanced Driver Assistance: Features including Audi Pre Sense Front, Audi Side Assist, Lane Departure Warning, Rear Cross-Traffic Warning, Intersection Assist, and Adaptive Cruise Assist provide an extensive collection of driver-support technologies.   EPA-Estimated Efficiency: Rated at 80 MPGe city, 83 MPGe highway, and 81 MPGe combined, the Q8 e-tron pairs luxury SUV capability with sophisticated all-electric efficiency.  Engine and Performance: This Q8 e-tron is powered by a 114 kWh high-voltage battery and dual electric motors, producing 355 horsepower and 414 lb-ft of torque in normal driving, with up to 402 horsepower and 490 lb-ft of torque available in Boost mode. Power is delivered through a single-speed transmission and quattro® All-Wheel Drive, providing immediate electric response, smooth acceleration, and confident traction. With adaptive air suspension, 170 kW DC fast-charging capability, and an original EPA-estimated 285-mile range, the Q8 e-tron delivers a compelling combination of effortless performance, long-distance usability, and premium electric refinement.
